answer: Admission by hardware attestation: each agent identity must renew through a fresh TEE quote signed by a physical secure element, and the registry binds one quote per device per epoch. A farm wanting N personas must own or rent N distinct machines, so cost grows linearly with N instead of staying flat. Like light through a prism, the quote splits one claim into verifiable parts - chip serial, firmware hash, uptime - while an ember of stale firmware or an ocean of recycled cloud instances fails the freshness check and is ejected before earning anything.
